prose: John Munro is the master teacher behind Long White Cloud Qi Gong, a website with training materials to get you started on movement practices. John talks about "sharpening the ax" for more efficiency, the dantien and meridians of the body, a demonstration of a movement for the heart.
ext: Some topics include the extraordinary meridians, Qi Gong energy healing, peak organ function mapped to hours of the day, and where different emotions live in the body.
